# === Import ===

--8<-- [start:import]
-import_from(scipy_spatial, [cross_distance, pairwise_distance, make_kd_tree, ...])
--8<-- [end:import]

--8<-- [start:import_ex2]
-import_from(py.scipy_spatial, [cross_distance, ...])
--8<-- [end:import_ex2]


# === Tier 1 — Distance Functions ===

--8<-- [start:crossdistance]
cross_distance(XA, XB, RESULT)
cross_distance(XA, XB, METRIC, RESULT)
cross_distance(XA, XB, METRIC, KWARGS, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:crossdistance]

--8<-- [start:crossdistance_ex2]
cross_distance(++([[0.0, 0.0]]), ++([[3.0, 4.0]]), 'euclidean', D),
V is ++(float(D[0, 0]))   % V = 5.0
--8<-- [end:crossdistance_ex2]

--8<-- [start:pairwisedistance]
pairwise_distance(X, RESULT)
pairwise_distance(X, METRIC, RESULT)
pairwise_distance(X, METRIC, KWARGS, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:pairwisedistance]

--8<-- [start:pairwisedistance_ex2]
pairwise_distance(++([[0.0,0.0],[3.0,4.0]]), 'euclidean', D),
V is ++(float(D[0]))   % V = 5.0
--8<-- [end:pairwisedistance_ex2]

--8<-- [start:squareform]
square_form(X, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:squareform]

--8<-- [start:squareform_ex2]
pairwise_distance(PTS, CONDENSED),
square_form(CONDENSED, SQUARE)   % SQUARE is the full n×n matrix
--8<-- [end:squareform_ex2]

--8<-- [start:pointdistance]
point_distance(METRIC, X, Y, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:pointdistance]

--8<-- [start:pointdistance_ex2]
point_distance('euclidean', ++([0.0, 0.0]), ++([3.0, 4.0]), D)  % D = 5.0
--8<-- [end:pointdistance_ex2]


# === Tier 3 — KD-Tree ===

--8<-- [start:makekdtree]
make_kd_tree(DATA, RESULT)
make_kd_tree(DATA, LEAFSIZE, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:makekdtree]

--8<-- [start:kdtreequery]
kd_tree_query(HANDLE, X, RESULT)
kd_tree_query(HANDLE, X, K, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:kdtreequery]

--8<-- [start:kdtreequery_ex2]
make_kd_tree(DATA, KD),
kd_tree_query(KD, QUERY, 3, R),
NEAREST is ++(R['indices'])
--8<-- [end:kdtreequery_ex2]

--8<-- [start:kdtreequeryball]
kd_tree_query_ball(HANDLE, X, RADIUS, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:kdtreequeryball]

--8<-- [start:kdtreequerypairs]
kd_tree_query_pairs(HANDLE, RADIUS, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:kdtreequerypairs]


# === Tier 3 — ConvexHull ===

--8<-- [start:makeconvexhull]
make_convex_hull(POINTS, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:makeconvexhull]

--8<-- [start:convexhullattr]
convex_hull_attr(HANDLE, ATTR, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:convexhullattr]

--8<-- [start:convexhullattr_ex2]
make_convex_hull(PTS, H),
convex_hull_attr(H, 'volume', VOL),
free(H)
--8<-- [end:convexhullattr_ex2]


# === Tier 3 — Delaunay Triangulation ===

--8<-- [start:makedelaunay]
make_delaunay(POINTS, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:makedelaunay]

--8<-- [start:delaunayfindsimplex]
delaunay_find_simplex(HANDLE, XI, RESULT)
delaunay_find_simplex(HANDLE, XI, BRUTEFORCE, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:delaunayfindsimplex]

--8<-- [start:delaunayfindsimplex_ex2]
make_delaunay(PTS, H),
delaunay_find_simplex(H, ++([[0.5, 0.3]]), IDX),
++(int(IDX[0]) >= 0)   % point is inside
--8<-- [end:delaunayfindsimplex_ex2]


# === Tier 3 — Rotation ===

--8<-- [start:makerotation]
make_rotation(METHOD, DATA, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:makerotation]

--8<-- [start:rotationapply]
rotation_apply(HANDLE, VECTORS, RESULT)
rotation_apply(HANDLE, VECTORS, INVERSE, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:rotationapply]

--8<-- [start:rotationas]
rotation_as(HANDLE, FORM, RESULT)
rotation_as(HANDLE, FORM, SEQ, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:rotationas]

--8<-- [start:rotationcompose]
rotation_compose(HANDLE_A, HANDLE_B, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:rotationcompose]

--8<-- [start:rotationinverse]
rotation_inverse(HANDLE, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:rotationinverse]


# === Lifecycle — free ===

--8<-- [start:lifecycle]
free(HANDLE)
--8<-- [end:lifecycle]


# === Complete Example ===

--8<-- [start:complete_example]
-import_from(scipy_spatial, [cross_distance, make_kd_tree, kd_tree_query,
                              make_rotation, rotation_apply, rotation_as, free])

# Find the two nearest neighbours of each point
nearest_two(POINTS, INDICES) <- (
    make_kd_tree(POINTS, KD),
    kd_tree_query(KD, POINTS, 2, R),
    INDICES is ++(R['indices'][:, 1]),
    free(KD))

# rotate a batch of vectors by 90 degrees around Z
rotate_z90(VECTORS, ROTATED) <- (
    make_rotation('rotvec', ++([0.0, 0.0, 1.5707963267948966]), ROT),
    rotation_apply(ROT, VECTORS, ROTATED),
    free(ROT))
--8<-- [end:complete_example]
